value.description: Book-weight transitional serif (font inferred, not identified), sentence case, ink #1A151A on cream, one centred line: OCR line box 10.6-12.1% of frame height and 70-85% of frame width (positioning line x 0.155-0.850, y 0.42-0.53; summary line up to x 0.079-0.926). Two-line benefit lines use a smaller size, line box 8.1% each with about 1% leading gap. Builds by word groups in final position (no reflow) with a 3-frame opacity fade.
Same serif at about 7.5-8% line box, two centred lines below the source card (y 0.61 and 0.70), ink on cream, fading in by line (F340, F345).

Neo-grotesque sans, regular, sentence case, white on a dark rounded bubble (#141316 or near-black), left aligned inside the bubble; on title cards the bubble text box is about 4.2% of frame height and the bubble sits top right (x 0.61-0.92, y 0.11) for the user and bottom left (x 0.17-0.46, y 0.78) for the reply; in the chat scene the bubble is centred and its text box is about 6% of height. A tiny bold sender name sits above the message.
Sans, medium weight, white on charcoal, centred under the mark (y 0.67-0.75, line box about 7-8% of height), building word by word.
Small sans in the replica interfaces (card handles, post text, time stamps, chips), 1.4-3.5% of frame height; channel colour lives in small icons and chips, not in the type.
Tiny white sans label on a terracotta #D97656 rounded tag attached to a pointer or caret; it is the assistant's presence in every interface and in the summary line.
Bold custom wordmark with a square mark, centred, about 36% of frame width and 24% line box including the mark; one small sans tagline line beneath at 4.4% line box, centred, grey-ink.

composition.value: Landscape 1280x720 at 30 fps. Title and claim cards: one centred line at mid-height (centre y about 0.47-0.49), at least 7% side margin, everything else empty cream, with chat bubbles pinned to the corners (top right for the user, bottom left for the reply) so the centre line is never covered. Loader: a single mark about 18% of frame width at centre (y about 0.40) with its label below and a small chip anchored bottom left (x 0.05, y 0.88). Result scenes: a faint square grid on cream; one hero object centred, then a 3x2 grid of cards filling about 85% of width; the calendar fills the frame and after the pull-back sits inside a rounded panel with about 4% cream margin. Chat scene: one centred column of bubbles about 38% of width. End card: mark and wordmark centred with the tagline beneath. The hook's 3x2 dark grid occupies about 90% of the frame.
evidence: speech-text.json box centres cx 0.500-0.504 for every title, caption and label

materials.value: Flat graphic interface replicas: white rounded cards with soft drop shadows on cream, dark rounded cards with hairline borders on charcoal, pill chips in channel colours, a faint square grid on light result grounds. No photography, no 3D, no texture or grain; the only illustrative element is the two-disc mark joined by a looping white stroke.

lighting.value: No light: flat fills only. Depth comes from soft card shadows on cream and from the swap between light (L 87-95) and dark (L 4-11) grounds shot to shot.

styleSummary: Warm-cream editorial meets dark product chrome: a calm book serif for every claim, small sans interface replicas for every proof, two accents (terracotta for the assistant, violet for the partner) and hard cuts alternating light and dark grounds on a 4-beat grid.
